comparison.objective: Remove a corrugated insert and hand three supply boxes through a partition to clean storage.
comparison.physical_skill: Cross-partition bimanual handovers and material segregation, not precision tool use or force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Boxes reach the clean shelf and cardboard stays on the dirty side; exact shelf tolerances are not given.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained logistics and contamination-zone compliance, not mechanical adjustment.
